_comment: AllMight notification rules — v1.0. Boss ruling 2026-04-12.

startup.description: Sent when start_all.sh launches the stack

watchdog_degraded.description: Sent when watchdog reports DEGRADED — one alert per cooldown window

watchdog_failed.description: Sent when watchdog reports FAILED — highest urgency

watchdog_recovery.description: Sent once when watchdog returns to HEALTHY after DEGRADED/FAILED

first_candidate.description: Sent on first CANDIDATE_CONFIRMED in a session above confidence threshold

candidate_count_threshold.description: Sent every time confirmed candidate count crosses a multiple of threshold

stop_summary.description: Sent by start_all.sh stop — session metrics digest

_suppression_reason: These events fire too frequently for push notifications. Session summaries and post-stop analysis cover them.
